## ResolvedGovernanceContext type

A [GovernanceContext](./runtime.governancecontext.md) with the authenticated key's policy resolved for one caller.

Distributes over the union, so the approvals arm survives resolution: a resolved context that came in with an approval gate still carries it (and its required writer) on the way out.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ResolvedGovernanceContext = GovernanceContext & {
  readonly keyPolicy?: GovernancePolicy | undefined
}
```

**References:** [GovernanceContext](./runtime.governancecontext.md)<!-- -->, [GovernancePolicy](./core.governancepolicy.md)
